en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: This course is intended to continue the development of the four main English language skills (reading, writing, listening and speaking) and to improve students' general knowledge of English grammar. The level achieved will depend on to a large extent on the individual student, but the aim is to teach at an upper intermediate level. In addition, there is a strong emphasis on acquiring specialist vocabulary in a range of topics related to viticulture and horticulture.
